study: Distill actions actually issued by the original examiner back into its own native pre-search root prior. No third-party actions, models, or packages. No new games.
training: All 24 training physical maps and both seats of opponent_policy/protocol.json. Score separately the four old held maps and seven completed games of dev1/four other maps; dev1 bilateral startup failure has zero actions. For every game take the fixed steps t=7+13*k, k=0..22. Exclude 621758590 and 621758591 and all future formal maps; old expert protocol's 80 maps not consumed.
information: Own actual original expert seat's six public fields at time t, original BeliefTracker using only its own previous emitted actions. Native NumPy _Policy.forward consumes exact rounded 54 planes; extract frozen 96 pre-head features from the same call. No opponent panorama or same-step action, no score or future input. Cases at t=7..293 require full official tape and correct original identity.
fit: Single CPU, a single fit per base and worker (no image rotation or data tuning). Separate ridge linear logit corrections on 96 own root hidden channels and bias using per-training-map balanced cross entropy, plus 1.0 KL(original||new), L2 0.1*||w||^2 on standardized inputs, up to 70 iterations L-BFGS. Omit base rows with worker quota already full or cash below 30, otherwise retain actually issued command including NONE. All worker outcomes included. Halve correction on training data until mean KL <= 0.025 and max absolute correction <= 2.0. Float16 serialize, and use dequantized parameters for all scoring. Seed used solely for paired held replay = 9023+1000003*(t+1)+17*expert_seat+31*(seed%10000).
measure: Predict issued post-search actions. Paired A0 controls use exact native root _act with its cash, occupancy, retirement, endgame bank and go_home, under identical controlled RNG. A0 is a measurable deployment entry decision and candidate generator, not a post-search win. Report all selected roots and full joint action exact match, worker and base hit, NLL, roots with changed predicted team. Economic pre-action opportunity: loaded collector >=50 adjacent to a base (deposit); lighter enemy <=2 of our loaded collector (cargo safety); planter standing on enemy tree (capture). Compare correct unit movement on the union of those opportunities, plus TP/FP/FN for actual next-cell deposit, projected lighter-rival collision using both real simultaneous orders post hoc, and actual planter staying on enemy tree. Keep opportunity, actual, and mistaken counts.
promotion: Both held sets independently must show strict improvement in actual worker action hits, full team exact matches at least unchanged, and strict improvement in economic-opportunity worker hits; at least three of four maps nonnegative for worker and for full team. Do not select parameters on either set. Failure: archive model and counterexamples, do not export competition candidate, run game, or declare gains. Success: only then exact single-file derivative without a second root network pass, frozen-weight/zero-readout source equivalence, actual full-search root changes, followed by separately authorized development games.
evidence: Registered before extracting or measuring this study's targets or features. Current tape owners supplied fixed source split; previous studies on these maps were known, so this is held-out-by-map historical analysis. Root K/H not presumed from historical tapes; if genuine signed counts exist, report them separately.
